description: Erection of a single-storey rear extension and a new side entrance door to rear flank elevation, together with internal alterations
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (22633-P1-Location Plan, 22633-P1-06 Rev A, 22633-P1-05 Rev A, 22633-P1-04 Rev A,  22633-P1-03 Rev A,  22633-P1-02 Rev A,  22633-P1-07 Rev A,  22633-P1-01 Rev A,  22633-P1-15 Rev A,  22633-P1-14 Rev D,  22633-P1-13 Rev C, 22633-P1-12 Rev D,  22633-P1-11 Rev D, 22633-P1-10 Rev A,  22633-P1-16 Rev C: Received 14/11/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
